details:
Q1. Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A. The issue → PR pipeline workflows (clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix) and their scripts (RECOMMENDED)
B. The orchestrator (orchestrate / orchestrate_poll and their helpers)
C. Documentation only (README.md, docs/, agents.d/ fragments)
D. Something else: please name the file, workflow or feature
Q2. What specific problem should be fixed, or what improvement is wanted?
Choices:
A. A concrete bug or failure: please give the symptom, a failing run or log, and the expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Performance or cost: fewer runner jobs, fewer API calls, or lower token use (say which)
C. Reliability: fewer stalls or retries, or better self-healing (say which path)
D. Usability or clarity of comments, alerts or docs (say which)
Q3. How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A. A measurable result you give, such as a metric threshold, a test that passes or a run that succeeds (RECOMMENDED)
B. A described before/after behavior that a contract test can check
C. A reviewer judges it qualitatively (not recommended; this cannot be checked automatically)
